name: Ochingin wa Karadabarai
original_name: おちんぎんは身体払い
source:
The protagonist, who started sugar dating with a beautiful female president he met during his student days, still continues this relationship while working under that president. In the midst of this, he starts sugar dating with a high school girl he happened to meet, and the cycle of sugar dating begins to spin. To make matters more interesting, his two partners introduce their respective friends to the protagonist as new partners for sugar dating, expanding the cycle of those activities even further. Not only does the number of partners increase, but the circles of sugar dating intersect...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1274778]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公在学生时代就与一位美丽的女总统开始了糖约会，并在这位总统手下工作期间仍然延续着这种关系。在此期间，他开始与偶然遇到的一名高中女生进行糖约会，糖约会的循环开始旋转。更有趣的是，他的两个伙伴将各自的朋友介绍给主角作为糖约会的新伙伴，进一步扩大了这些活动的周期。不仅伴侣数量增加，糖交友圈子也出现交叉……
